description.en: Deiphon barrandei has an inflated rounded glabella and a very narrow segmented trunk framed by long spines. Underside limbs, antennae, colour and thickness are inferred from dorsal fossil evidence, without claims about buoyancy or feeding.
description.zh: Deiphon barrandei 具有膨大的圆形头鞍和被长刺环绕的极窄分节躯干。腹面肢、触角、颜色及体厚由背面化石证据推断，不据此主张浮力机制或摄食方式。

construction_notes: One segmented trunk mesh and grouped spine geometry can preserve visible segmentation within budget.
Do not confuse pleural exoskeletal spines with walking legs; inferred legs sit underneath.
Use restrained brown palette as art, not fossil living-color evidence.

dimensions_estimate_m.basis: Length follows plate caption; width and height are artistic estimates.

frozen_scientific_scope.final_evidence: Four exact-export front/side/top/perspective views; perspective may equal preview. Existing technical/export/viewer gates, two isolated rebuilds and fresh independent QA remain required.
frozen_scientific_scope.gray_model_gate: Three low-cost front/side/oblique checks before detailing; original inventory shape combination must read. No extra views except a specific unresolved problem.
frozen_scientific_scope.material_profile: palette-only static original geometry; restrained natural palette; no reference images embedded

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish inflated spherical glabella and extremely reduced narrow spiny trunk in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以球形膨大头鞍配极度缩窄的多刺躯干搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

shape_gate.en: Its distinguishing construction is inflated spherical glabella and extremely reduced narrow spiny trunk; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.
shape_gate.zh: 以球形膨大头鞍配极度缩窄的多刺躯干为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。

scientific_limits.en: Ventral limbs, antennae, color, posture and body thickness are inferred, not preserved in the consulted dorsal photograph. The 3.5 cm plate caption anchors approximate length, not an exact reconstructed individual. No buoyancy or feeding behavior is asserted.
scientific_limits.zh: 腹面肢、触角、颜色、姿态与体厚为推断，并非所查背面照片保存的信息。图版所标3.5厘米仅作为近似长度依据，不是精确个体复原。不主张其浮力机制或摄食行为。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original living stylization of Deiphon barrandei guided by actual fossil photograph, not a specimen replica.
shape_requirements: Preserve original spherical inflated glabella plus extremely reduced narrow spiny trunk.
Large bulbous glabella dominates anterior profile; narrow segmented axial body and separate swept pleural spines, not a broad solid oval shell.
Paired long curved genal spines and paired rear pointed extensions follow dorsal fossil silhouette.
Small lateral eyes remain subordinate; inferred ventral appendages must not obscure dorsal spaces.
